name: Cimmerian-Dirge
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, impact-scarred wastelands emerge like the bones of the planet.

Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the monolithic structures of unknown origin left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
